tools.name: ios_simulator_list
tools.description: List available iOS Simulator devices and the currently attached device.

tools.name: ios_simulator_attach
tools.description: Attach one iOS Simulator device to the Verboo desktop session. Provide either udid, or both model and iosVersion. Do not combine the two selector forms.

udid.description: Exact device identifier. Use this by itself instead of model and iosVersion.

model.description: Exact device model name. Must be provided together with iosVersion and without udid.

iosVersion.description: Exact iOS runtime version. Must be provided together with model and without udid.

tools.name: ios_simulator_wait_until_ready
tools.description: Wait for the attached iOS Simulator preview and interaction transport to become ready without shell sleeps or polling.

tools.name: ios_simulator_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a frame from the attached iOS Simulator, optionally waiting for a generation newer than the last observed frame.

tools.name: ios_simulator_focused_element
tools.description: Read only the currently keyboard-focused control and its bounded label/value fields. This never requests the full accessibility hierarchy.

tools.name: ios_simulator_tap
tools.description: Tap a control in the attached iOS Simulator. Semantic-first rule: when the intended control has visible text or a known accessibility identifier, you must provide target. Verboo uses target as the primary locator and does not fall back to an unrelated coordinate tap when it cannot resolve that target. Coordinates are an optional disambiguation hint when supplied as a complete x and y pair. Omit target only when no usable text or identifier exists. You must provide target, both coordinates, or target with both coordinates.

x.description: Normalized horizontal coordinate. With target it is only a disambiguation hint; without target it is the coordinate locator.

y.description: Normalized vertical coordinate. With target it is only a disambiguation hint; without target it is the coordinate locator.

target.description: Primary semantic locator. You must provide it when the intended control has visible text or a known accessibility identifier; omit it only when neither exists.

tools.name: ios_simulator_drag
tools.description: Drag between two normalized points in the attached iOS Simulator.

tools.name: ios_simulator_type_text
tools.description: Type text into the focused control in the attached iOS Simulator. Verify the resulting value with ios_simulator_focused_element before reporting success.

tools.name: ios_simulator_press_key
tools.description: Press a supported key in the attached iOS Simulator.

tools.name: ios_simulator_system_action
tools.description: Perform a generic iOS system action on the attached Simulator.

tools.name: ios_simulator_list_apps
tools.description: List installed applications on the attached iOS Simulator, including their display names and bundle identifiers.

tools.name: ios_simulator_launch_app
tools.description: Launch any installed application on the attached iOS Simulator by bundle identifier.

tools.name: ios_simulator_detach
tools.description: Detach Verboo from the current iOS Simulator without shutting the device down.
